title: Stormy Kelp Shore
description: Dramatic seascape featuring large swirling green and yellow kelp fronds in the foreground growing among dark wet rocks. Turbulent ocean waves with white foam crash against the shore under a moody purple and pink cloudy sky with a small glowing sun breaking through.
